title: Turing-profile-v1.0 terminal receipt
description: final_receipt.json written by turing-cal-eval instead of the normal measurement receipt in two cases (calibration/docs/FAILURE_REPORTING.md section 2): kind terminal_fail = a check failed after the first score was computed (verdict FAIL; the failing criterion FAIL, every other NOT_REACHED, which counts as FAIL); kind inconclusive_infra = the third void attempt in sealed mode (verdict INCONCLUSIVE, reason INFRA). Written once, exclusive create, never replaced.

criteria.description: terminal_fail only: S1-S9, each FAIL or NOT_REACHED

failed_criterion.description: terminal_fail only: S1, S3, S4, S6 or NONE (infrastructure failure after scoring: every criterion NOT_REACHED)
